title: Restore Version 55 and fix backend canister configuration so dashboard, admin panel, and ordering work

requirements.text: Restore/roll back the project to Version 55 as the active codebase and rebuild the project from that version.

quotes: Can you go back to build 55

acceptanceCriteria: The codebase reflects Version 55 as the active version (not Version 58).
A clean build completes for the restored Version 55 project.

requirements.text: Fix the production configuration flow so the app can reliably determine the backend canister ID (via VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID at build-time or via /runtime-config.json at runtime for static hosting), and ensure pages do not route to a generic error page due to missing canister ID when the runtime config is correctly set.

quotes: fix the dashboard and placing orders not working same error page ones up when i click both make sure website fully works

acceptanceCriteria: When VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID is set to a valid principal at build time, navigating to Dashboard, Admin Panel, and placing an order works without showing the "Configuration Error" screen.
When VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID is empty/missing, setting a valid principal in /runtime-config.json (deployed static site) allows the app to connect after a reload and the same flows work.
If the backend canister ID is missing/invalid, the app shows the dedicated configuration error screen with diagnostics (not a generic router error page).

requirements.text: Update user-facing error/help text related to static hosting configuration so it references the correct deployed file path and workflow (e.g., editing the deployed runtime-config.json), and ensure the troubleshooting steps are accurate and actionable in English.

quotes: same error page ones up when i click both make sure website fully works

acceptanceCriteria: The configuration error screen’s "How to Fix" instructions reference the deployed runtime config file path ("/runtime-config.json" or "dist/runtime-config.json" depending on context) rather than source-repo paths like "frontend/public/runtime-config.json".
The instructions clearly distinguish IC deployment (build-time env) vs static hosting (runtime file) without requiring users to modify source code.

requirements.text: Ensure the dashboard, admin panel, and order placement flows function end-to-end against the Motoko backend when the backend canister ID is configured, including successful order creation from the cart/checkout flow and successful loading of user/admin order lists.

quotes: fix the dashboard and placing orders not working
fix admin panel just make sure everything works

acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can open /dashboard and see their orders load (or an empty state) without runtime configuration errors.
Authenticated users can complete the cart checkout/order placement flow without being redirected to an error page.
Admins can open /admin and load the admin panel without runtime configuration errors.
Backend health check and order APIs used by the frontend respond successfully when called with proper authentication and configuration.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if a state upgrade is required.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only shadcn components); compose them instead.

Do not modify immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new product features beyond fixing configuration/connectivity and restoring functionality (e.g., new payment providers, new user roles, new pages).
Integrating third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Introducing external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
